name: no right-column table fills the window
why: A (org/POH-table-sizing.org): the pass stops before the fill, so the setlist keeps the 460 px cap and a taller window only adds empty paper.

name: the pane is not sticky
why: A: scrolling the left column took the right table with it.

edits.find: .mb-dp-dialog .mb-dp-x > .mb-dp-col.mb-dp-pane { position: sticky; top: var(--mb-dp-pane-top, 0px); align-self: start; }
edits.replace: .mb-dp-dialog .mb-dp-x > .mb-dp-col.mb-dp-pane { position: static; top: var(--mb-dp-pane-top, 0px); align-self: start; }

name: a window resize does not size the tables again
why: A: the table follows the window's height only through the body's ResizeObserver.

name: the size pass runs after the scroll positions come back
why: A: a position restored into the 460 px box before it shrinks to the window loses the bottom of the table on every repaint.

name: a dragged height is not saved
why: D: the height must be kept per table for every later window (vzell 2026-10-31, answer 3).
grep: a grip under the left column

name: a later window does not read the saved heights
why: D: only the window the drag happened in would show the height.

edits.find: const px = key && drag && drag.key === key && drag.cur != null ? drag.cur : (key ? heights[key] : null);
edits.replace: const px = key && drag && drag.key === key && drag.cur != null ? drag.cur : null;

grep: a grip under the left column

name: Esc during a drag reaches the window
why: D: Esc must cancel the drag, not close the window with the drag half done.
grep: a grip under the left column

name: the grip lets the page scroll on touch
why: D on a phone: without touch-action none the finger scrolls the window and the drag is cancelled.

edits.find: cursor: ns-resize; touch-action: none; user-select: none;

name: a Discogs right-column table does not fill
why: Answer 4: every right-column table, not only MusicBrainz release groups and setlists. The pane is taken from the first two-column grid only when its columns stand side by side.
